text_block_list.name: Fresh Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was my first time watching a play, 
and it was so fun! I even gasped during 
the big reveal scene!

text_block_list.name: Fresh Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! My phone went off in the middle of 
it and startled me, though...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, yeah... A first play is fun, isn't 
it? And they put away their phone right 
away too. But...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't concentrate. Maybe I'll 
rewatch it another time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, even when training time 
arrived, the haze clouding Cesario's mind 
still hadn't cleared.
